events.title: Demo updated - V81 Revision notes
events.summary: V81 DEMO Revision Notes:Majorly updated/improved CAT behaviours! The cat will chase your laser dot now! You can also feed the kitty, and much more…Major cat improvements and additions: -Cat will now save an affinity level for individual players in servers. You can grow the affinity with the cat by standing close to it, speaking directly to it and playing with a laser tool with it. As cats like you more and more, they will cat smile at you (squinting their eyes), purr more near you, come near you
